lines: - "Exalted: the dissident remains entrenched in the shadows below. The sea runs crimson with the blood of our faithful. But... I will prevail. In Narmer's name. All as one."
- "The unclean spirit thins our herd from the shadows. It will not matter. My faith is too strong. The light of Narmer will bring it the truth. All as one."
- "Only... only I remain. A test of my faith in trembling light. But! I am not afraid. Ballas will save me, his love is within me! All as One. All... as..."
